Population increased in Preston

The estimated population of Preston in 2024 was 162,864 usual residents, a rise of 2.9% since 2023.

This meant that Preston's rate of population change placed it among the 10 percent fastest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Preston increased by 10.2%.

Over this slightly longer period, Preston was also among the 10% fastest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Preston

The average (median) age fell to 35.3 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Preston has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Preston is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Preston's population of 162,864 usual residents was made up of:

  • 32,341 people aged 0 to 15 years, (19.9%)
  • 107,301 people aged 16 to 64 years, (65.9%)
  • 23,222 people aged 65 years and over, (14.3%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Preston has a slightly lower proportion of people aged 65 years and over (14.3% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Preston, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Preston
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Preston, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 390 people (0.2%). In total, there were 1,764 births and 1,374 deaths in Preston.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) led to a fall in the population of 132 (-0.1%). There were 11,700 people entering the area and 11,832 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Preston's population of 4,249 (2.7%) as a result of 6,226 people entering the area and 1,977 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Preston was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Preston in mid-2023 is 158,317.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 1,958 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 52 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 1,906 people.
